Weekly Meal Planner

Plan breakfast, lunch and dinner for 7 days; saves automatically and prints nicely.

MealMonTueWedThuFriSatSun

Edits save automatically.

📖 How to use

  1. Click any cell and type the meal for that day.
  2. The plan saves automatically as you type.
  3. Optionally rename the week label at the top.
  4. Click Print / Save PDF to print or download it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I fill in the plan?

Click any cell and type a meal. Every edit saves automatically to this browser.

What days and meals does it cover?

The grid covers Monday–Sunday with breakfast, lunch and dinner rows. Change the week label if you want.

How do I print it?

Click Print / Save PDF and use your browser's print dialog. The plan prints as a clean table.

Is my meal plan saved?

Yes — everything is stored in localStorage on this device.
